claims_boundary: This is a planning comparison between a draft Bitcoin transition schedule and a forward vendor hardware roadmap. It is not a Q-day prediction, proof of a CRQC, or proof that the vendor target will be achieved.

bitcoin_schedule.name: BIP-361 Post Quantum Migration and Legacy Signature Sunset

interpretation: The five-year BIP-361 schedule is measured from activation, not from proposal publication.
Because BIP-361 is not consensus-active, immediate-start modeling is optimistic; any activation delay makes the margin smaller.
The 2028 hardware roadmap is forward-looking and must never be represented as demonstrated attack capability or Q-day.
The collision is therefore a migration-schedule risk signal: protocol, wallet, custody, relay, rescue, and user migration work should proceed in parallel rather than serially.
